root_cause.text: f2fs_rename() performs irreversible on-disk directory modifications (updating target entry and deleting source entry) before attempting to add the whiteout entry via f2fs_add_link; if the whiteout addition fails, the dentry cache is not invalidated, causing a mismatch between cached dentries and the modified on-disk state, which leads to a WARNING in drop_nlink() on subsequent rename operations due to stale dentries pointing to inodes with zero i_nlink.
root_cause.evidence: The patch description details the sequence where partial directory modifications are committed to disk before f2fs_add_link fails, VFS does not call d_move() due to the error, leaving new_dentry pointing to the old inode (i_nlink already zero), and a second rename on the same target triggers drop_nlink on that stale inode. The fix explicitly adds d_invalidate(old_dentry) and d_invalidate(new_dentry) in the error path of f2fs_add_link during whiteout creation, forcing cache refresh from disk on subsequent operations.

The fix explicitly adds d_invalidate(old_dentry) and d_invalidate(new_dentry) in the error path of f2fs_add_link during whiteout creation, forcing cache refresh from disk on subsequent operations.
